fields.title: Hypertension
fields.bodyHtml:
Hypertension: a balanced approach to controlling blood pressure

Introduction

Hypertension, or raised blood pressure, is one of the most common cardiovascular conditions and affects millions of people worldwide. High blood pressure can bring serious complications such as stroke, heart attack and damage to the organs. Timely diagnosis and effective treatment are essential to controlling it. In this article we describe the methods of diagnosis and treatment and the advantages of treating hypertension in Israel.

Methods of diagnosis

Accurate diagnosis of hypertension plays a decisive part in choosing a treatment strategy. Modern medicine offers a range of diagnostic methods, including:

  • Blood pressure measurement: the simplest and most accessible way of diagnosing hypertension. Raised pressure is usually identified through repeated measurements at different times.
  • 24-hour blood pressure monitoring: continuous recording of blood pressure over 24 hours for a more accurate assessment of how it changes at different times of day.
  • Laboratory tests: measurement of cholesterol, glucose, creatinine and other markers helps assess the risk of complications and determine a suitable treatment plan.

Methods of treatment

Treatment of hypertension aims to lower blood pressure and prevent complications. It may include:

  • Lifestyle changes: changes to diet, more physical activity and giving up smoking help lower blood pressure and improve general health.
  • Drug therapy: doctors may prescribe antihypertensive medicines to control blood pressure and reduce the risk of complications.
  • Nerve blocks: an innovative treatment that involves blocking the sympathetic nerves that control blood pressure.
  • Renal revascularisation: in some cases, where hypertension is linked to narrowing of the renal arteries, a revascularisation procedure may be needed to restore normal blood flow.

Advantages of treatment in Israel

Israel is a medical centre of world class, where doctors use advanced technologies and innovative treatments for hypertension. The advantages of treating hypertension in Israel include:

  • Qualified specialists: Israeli cardiologists and vascular surgeons have a high level of knowledge and experience in treating hypertension.
  • An integrated approach: Israel takes a whole-person approach to treating hypertension, combining drug therapy with changes in lifestyle.
  • Research and development: medical institutions in Israel take an active part in research into new treatments for hypertension, which gives access to advanced technologies and procedures.

Conclusion

Hypertension is a serious condition that requires timely diagnosis and appropriate treatment. Modern methods of diagnosis and the range of available treatments make it possible to control blood pressure and prevent complications. Israel, as a medical centre of world class, provides high-quality treatment for hypertension through advanced technology and an individual approach to every patient. If you have problems with your blood pressure, you should consult a specialist and take steps to control it and protect the health of your heart and circulation.

fields.title: High blood pressure
fields.bodyHtml:
High blood pressure: advanced treatment in Israel

Hypertension, or raised blood pressure, is an important risk factor for cardiovascular disease. Israel takes a comprehensive approach to diagnosing and treating hypertension, combining drug and non-drug strategies to manage the condition.

Diagnosis of hypertension:

  1. Blood pressure measurement
    Regular monitoring of blood pressure to assess its level and fluctuations.
  2. Laboratory tests
    Blood and urine tests to identify possible causes of raised pressure and to assess the kidneys, heart and endocrine system.
  3. Electrocardiogram (ECG)
    To identify possible changes in the work of the heart caused by long-standing raised pressure.
  4. Echocardiography
    Ultrasound examination to assess the structure and function of the heart, including the thickness of the walls and the state of the valves.

Methods of treating hypertension:

  1. Drug treatment:
    • Antihypertensive medicines: including ACE inhibitors, angiotensin II receptor blockers, diuretics, beta blockers and calcium channel blockers.
    • Statins and other medicines to control cholesterol where needed.
  2. Lifestyle changes:
    • A diet low in sodium and rich in potassium.
    • Regular moderate exercise.
    • Weight loss where there is obesity.
    • Giving up smoking and moderating alcohol intake.
  3. Education and support for patients:
    • Programmes to raise patients' awareness of the importance of controlling blood pressure and following medical advice.

Advantages of treatment in Israel:

  • A multidisciplinary approach: cardiologists, endocrinologists, dietitians and other specialists work together to manage the condition as well as possible.
  • Personalised treatment: an individual treatment plan drawn up after a thorough assessment of the patient's health.
  • Innovative treatments: the latest advances in medicine are applied to control hypertension effectively.
  • A high standard of medical care: the use of modern technology and equipment for accurate diagnosis and treatment.

fields.title: Hypospadias
fields.bodyHtml:
Introduction

Hypospadias is a congenital abnormality in boys in which the opening of the urethra lies below its normal position on the head of the penis. It is a serious condition that can considerably affect quality of life and the ability to lead a normal sexual life. In this article we look at the methods of diagnosing and treating hypospadias and the advantages of having it treated in Israel.

Methods of diagnosis

Hypospadias is usually diagnosed when a newborn boy is examined by a doctor. Although some forms are apparent immediately after birth, doctors often need further investigation to establish the exact position of the urethral opening and the degree of the abnormality. The main diagnostic methods are:

  • Visual examination: the doctor examines the urinary and reproductive organs to establish where the urethral opening lies on the penis.
  • Ultrasound examination: may be carried out for a more detailed study of the anatomy of the urinary tract and to assess the degree of hypospadias.
  • Urethrography: an X-ray method used to image the urethra and determine the exact position of the opening.
  • Consultation with a geneticist: in some cases hypospadias may be linked to genetic abnormalities, so a genetic consultation may be needed.

Methods of treatment

Hypospadias is usually treated surgically. The aim of the operation is to correct the position of the urethral opening and restore the normal anatomy of the penis. The particular approach depends on the degree of hypospadias and the patient's age. The main treatments are:

  • Corrective surgery: carried out to move the urethral opening to its correct position on the head of the penis.
  • Reconstructive surgery: in complex forms of hypospadias, or where there are additional abnormalities of the urinary tract, reconstructive surgery may be needed to restore normal anatomy.
  • Treatment in adults: in some men hypospadias remains uncorrected from childhood. Surgical correction can then be carried out in adulthood to improve function and appearance.

Advantages of treatment in Israel

Israel is a world leader in medical tourism, attracting patients from around the world with its high standard of medical services and advanced technology. Patients who choose Israel for the treatment of hypospadias gain the following advantages:

  • Experienced specialists: Israeli surgeons who specialise in hypospadias have extensive experience and professionalism. They trained at leading medical institutions and have high expertise in this field.
  • Innovative treatments: medical centres in Israel use advanced methods of diagnosing and treating hypospadias. This allows the best results to be achieved and minimises the risk of complications.
  • An individual approach: Israeli doctors understand how important it is to treat every patient individually. They take account of the particular features of each case and draw up the most effective and safest treatment plan.
  • Comprehensive support: patients who come to Israel for treatment receive full support at every stage of the trip. Coordinators help with travel arrangements and interpreting and provide the information needed.

Conclusion

Hypospadias is a serious congenital condition that can be corrected successfully by surgery. The operation improves quality of life and restores normal function. Thanks to its medical expertise and advanced technology, Israel offers patients the best conditions for successful treatment. If you or your child has been diagnosed with hypospadias, you should consult a qualified specialist and consider treatment in Israel to achieve the best results.

fields.title: Glaucoma
fields.bodyHtml:
Glaucoma is a group of eye conditions marked by damage to the optic nerve, often associated with raised pressure inside the eye. It is a progressive condition that can lead to loss of sight and even blindness if left untreated.

Diagnosis of glaucoma

  1. Ophthalmoscopy: allows the doctor, using special instruments, to assess the state of the optic nerve, the vessels of the fundus and the retina.
  2. Gonioscopy: a method in which the doctor uses a thick contact lens with mirrors to examine the structure of the angle of the anterior chamber of the eye, through which fluid drains. This establishes the cause of any problem with the eye's drainage system.
  3. Visual field test: carried out with a computerised perimeter to check peripheral vision.
  4. Optical tomography: allows the extent of damage to the optic nerve and the tissues of the eye to be assessed.
  5. Laser scanning: produces a layer-by-layer image of the eye.
  6. Ultrasound examination of the eye: doctors use this to assess the optic nerve, the posterior chamber and the retina.
  7. Doppler examination of the vessels of the eye: often used together with ultrasound to assess the blood supply to the eye.

Methods of treating glaucoma

  1. Drug therapy: used at an early stage of the condition. It includes eye drops to lower the pressure inside the eye, stimulation of the blood supply to the optic nerve and the inner coats of the eye, and restoration of metabolic processes in the tissues of the eye. The newer medicines used in Israeli clinics are highly effective with minimal side effects.
  2. Laser treatment:
    • Laser trabeculoplasty: creating microscopic openings in the drainage system of the eye to improve the outflow of fluid.
    • Laser iridotomy: creating a small opening in the iris to improve the circulation of fluid in closed-angle glaucoma.
    • Cyclophotocoagulation: laser treatment to reduce the production of fluid inside the eye.
  3. Surgical treatment:
    • Trabeculectomy: creating a new channel for fluid to drain, which lowers the pressure inside the eye.
    • Drainage implants: fitting small tubes to improve the outflow of fluid.
    • Minimally invasive glaucoma surgery (MIGS): newer technologies, such as micro-shunts, that make treatment less traumatic.
  4. Iridectomy: removal of part of the iris to improve the outflow of fluid in closed-angle glaucoma.
  5. Cyclophotocoagulation: a laser procedure to reduce the production of fluid inside the eye.

Advantages of treating glaucoma in Israel

  1. Highly qualified specialists: Israeli ophthalmologists have great experience and are recognised worldwide for their work in treating glaucoma.
  2. Modern equipment: clinics are equipped with the newest diagnostic and treatment devices, which ensures accuracy and effectiveness.
  3. An individual approach: every patient is given a personalised treatment plan that takes account of all aspects of their health.
  4. Interdisciplinary collaboration: doctors of various specialities work closely together to achieve the best treatment results.
  5. High standards of safety and quality: Israeli clinics adhere strictly to international protocols and standards of medical care.

Treatment of glaucoma in Israel gives patients access to highly qualified medical care, improves their quality of life and helps preserve their sight for many years.
